dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that part of your job, too?

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: No. It's just that I started out as a sapper, so I pay rather close attention to such things.

dialogues.speaker: Tikhon
dialogues.text: Who knows what might go wrong if fighting breaks out? Road conditions have to be monitored at all times.
